coverage_gap: The 2160-raster V28 shape supplement labels one marker per scene and excludes neighboring markers. Historical component/family rows remain, but the fixed family training set covers circle/square plots without overlapping marker discs. This new general recipe covers all nine shapes with separately labeled visible neighbors; it does not reuse development pixels, geometry or answers.

failure.limitation: Nearest-stage attribution is descriptive. A center within five pixels may belong to a neighboring point; these counts do not prove a unique causal fix or permit relaxing matching or rejection thresholds.

limitations: This hypothesis may address missing or displaced proposals, not every classifier rejection or NMS conflict.
New scenes add zero OCR/artifact masks; the exact existing masked training tensors remain in the union.
Some authored radii exceed the existing 8-pixel regression clamp and remain recorded.
preview_review: Inspected all 16 displayed scenes across four shapes and four neighbor contexts. Authored center overlays match visible glyph locations, including partially occluded neighbors.
unsupported_truths: Four visible authored markers have no assigned positive under the unchanged grid/support rule. They stay in the inventory; no fabricated positives or discarded scenes.
